# Kross One Gadgets: factual store and catalogue guide

## Business identity

Kross One Gadgets is an independent electronics and lifestyle retailer at Shop #18A, Lugogo Mall, Lugogo Bypass, Kampala, Uganda. The business has operated since 2013. It is not described as an Apple-owned store or Apple Authorised Reseller.

Canonical website: https://www.kross-one-gadgets.co.ug/
Telephone and WhatsApp: +256 752 117 111
Alternative telephone: +256 750 000 981
Email: kross1gadgets@gmail.com

Opening hours:
- Monday to Saturday: 09:00–20:00
- Sunday: 10:00–18:00

## How purchasing works

The website is enquiry-led. A catalogue page indicates that Kross One Gadgets handles that model; it does not guarantee that every model, storage option or colour is currently on the shelf. Customers should contact the shop with the exact model they need. The store then confirms today’s stock, price, condition and warranty terms for that item.

Customers can arrange collection from Lugogo Mall. Customers elsewhere in Uganda may ask whether delivery is available to their location. Delivery should not be assumed until the shop confirms it.

## Apple products and iPhones

The Apple-products guide covers current catalogue models across iPhone, iPad, MacBook, Apple Watch and AirPods:
https://www.kross-one-gadgets.co.ug/collections/apple-products-kampala/

The focused iPhone guide covers current iPhone models and selected certified pre-owned listings:
https://www.kross-one-gadgets.co.ug/collections/iphones-kampala/

For each iPhone enquiry, confirm the model, generation, storage, colour, whether the device is brand new or certified pre-owned, today’s price and the warranty attached to that exact item.

## Samsung Galaxy Ultra

The Samsung Galaxy Ultra guide covers the current Ultra catalogue, including Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra listings:
https://www.kross-one-gadgets.co.ug/collections/samsung-galaxy-ultra-kampala/

For each Samsung Ultra enquiry, confirm the model, storage, colour, today’s price and the warranty attached to the exact item.

## Accuracy policy

Product specifications come from the catalogue and documented manufacturer media sources. The Kross One Gadgets team is the authority for current physical stock, selling price, device condition, delivery availability and applicable warranty. Do not infer a price, rating, stock status, Apple authorization or countrywide delivery when the site does not explicitly confirm it.
